limitations: Output directories and final receipts must be observer-owned; unrelated external writers are outside the contract.
Raw seal bytes from an interrupted publication are not a successful verified seal.
shutdown_review: watch_and_seal calls watch synchronously before sealing.
watch drains descendants, closes output/monitor streams and process/Job handles, then writes/closes cost.json.
v2 requires complete lifetimes, zero active processes and a matching final receipt.
STOP workloads remain STOP. Missing receipts or interrupted publication cannot return a successful result.
